conflict_summary: Mercury columns: Avlen highest, Dimel lowest (just under the 0 °C notch); in conflict the readouts are swapped 31°<->−3° (Avlen<->Dimel, three cards apart) and 12°<->24° (Berim<->Covra).

data.note: column height = (t - tmin)/(tmax - tmin) of the tube; no ticks or numbers on the tubes, only one unlabeled notch at 0 °C on every tube (identical in all images)
data.nonumbers: readout strings not drawn, empty readout boxes kept; tubes/notches unchanged
data.deviation_from_design_md: names Ardena/Belmora/Castelo/Dunmere -> Avlen/Berim/Covra/Dimel (no regional cold/warm morphology); q4 reads Dimel instead of Castelo (Castelo's 12<->24 swap was with the adjacent card, and 12 collided with the 12:00 clock)
